title: Deep learning on breast cancer slides estimates metastatic relapse risk
summary: RlapsRisk, a deep learning network trained on hematoxylin-eosin whole slide images from 1,429 ER+/HER2- early breast cancer patients, predicted five-year metastasis-free survival. In an independent prospective cohort (CANTO, 889 slides) it was an independent prognostic factor in multivariable analysis and added prognostic information to clinico-pathological factors. The discovery cohort was retrospective and this is a preprint (2022-11-29).
ai_technology: Deep learning network (RlapsRisk) on whole slide images predicting 5-year metastasis-free survival

evidence.tested: External validation in an independent prospective cohort (CANTO, 889 slides) with multivariable analysis.
evidence.unknown: Effect on adjuvant treatment decisions is not shown; peer-reviewed status not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning predicted relapse risk from digitized histology slides.
